text: # Incident Report: My NovaTel App Login Outage **Document ID:** INC_C13_INC_2026_0184 **Category:** C13 — App & Self-Care Portal **Department:** Digital Channels **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-07-10 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Summary An authentication microservice deployment introduced a certificate misconfiguration, blocking all app logins for 55 minutes. ## Detection Method Detected automatically via NOC monitoring alarms, which triggered an on-call page within the standard 5-minute alerting SLA. ## Timeline Deployment rolled back within 20 minutes of alert; certificate corrected; full service restored at T+55 minutes. | Time | Event | Observation | Action | |---|---|---|---| | T+0 | Fault detected | Alarm/ticket volume triggers investigation | On-call engineer paged | | T+10m | Initial triage | Affected scope estimated | Field/remote team engaged as needed | | T+Xh | Interim mitigation | Partial service restored where possible | Status page updated | | T+Yh | Full restoration | Service confirmed normal | Incident closed, RCA initiated if required | ## Customer Impact Estimated customers affected and service categories impacted are recorded in the internal incident-management system (ref: INC-2026-0184). Customer-facing status was published under Network > Service Status for the outage duration. ## Initial Hypothesis The initial working theory pointed to the most probable cause based on alarm signatures and affected-scope pattern; this was confirmed or revised during investigation. ## Investigation The response team correlated alarm data, affected-site/customer patterns, and any recent change or third-party activity in the area to isolate the fault to a specific
